train_sentence_transformer_stsbenchmark: train a BERT or RoBERTa model on the STSbenchmark dataset for sentence embeddings using cosine similarity
configure_peft_lora_for_sentence_transfo: configure LoRA fine-tuning on a SentenceTransformer model with configurable rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules
setup_gaudi_training_arguments: setup Habana Gaudi training arguments for sentence transformer training with bf16, HPU graphs, and deepspeed support
create_cosine_similarity_loss: create a CosineSimilarityLoss for training sentence embeddings with paired sentences and similarity scores
evaluate_embedding_similarity: evaluate a trained sentence transformer model using an EmbeddingSimilarityEvaluator on the STSbenchmark test set
